law_name: Law on Copyright and Related Rights No. 726 of 13 November 1998 (as amended up to Law No. 1488 of 2 January 2018)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 17 per 2009 version; joint works from death of last co-author; anonymous works 50 years from lawful publication)
fair_use_exceptions: UNKNOWN (Art. 7 excludes official legal texts, state symbols, news facts and folklore from protection) (unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: Division on Copyright and Related Rights, Ministry of Culture
notes: Berne in force 9 Mar 2000; WCT 5 Apr 2009; WPPT 24 Aug 2011; WTO member 2 Mar 2013. No copyright-specific amendment found for 2020-2025; Civil Code (new, in force July 2023) may bear on copyright. Term may differ in post-2009 text (not verified).
